claim: AgentEvent in AgentEvents.ts is the renderer-agnostic event union consumed by the CLI, TUI, Web UI, service SSE, and Telegram; RunRoutes serializes it verbatim, the Web reducer treats unknown variants as no-ops, and the legacy verification variant is deprecated and not emitted by the current runner.

evidence.note: AgentEvent variants and the deprecated verification note.
Web applyRunEvent folds events; the default case ignores unknown variants.
TUI applyAgentEvent folds events into transcript state.
Run routes serialize the union verbatim as the wire contract.

claim: AgentRunner.run holds the session for the whole run, optionally plans, executes an approval-aware tool loop, records the final outcome in TaskStore, and persists one clean user/assistant pair; focused observable checks use ordinary tools and there is no separate model self-grade. MarifoldRuntime.createAgentRunner wires it.

evidence.note: Runner contract and run() holding the session lease around runReserved.
Completion persists one turn pair and omits the former self-grading phase.
createAgentRunner wires engines, TaskStore, session hold, persistTurn, and built-in guides.

claim: ApprovalPolicy.ts defines ToolKind, ApprovalMode, DEFAULT_AGENT_CONFIG, resolveAgentConfig, ApprovalRequest, and the ApprovalHandler callback; AgentRunner merges [agent.unattended] overrides for unattended runs, escalated risks turn allow into ask, and ask without a handler degrades to deny.

evidence.note: Unattended override merge, escalation, policy allow/deny, and deny without a handler.

claim: Agent tools implement AgentTool from ToolRegistry.ts, live in agent/tools/, and are registered in MarifoldRuntime.createDefaultToolRegistry: ask_user, attachment inspect/read/search, read_file, write_file, shell_exec, sudo_exec, shell_job_status, python_package_install, manage_skill, SkillApp tools, web_search/read_web_page when web search is enabled and network is not denied, and ask_profile.

evidence.note: createDefaultToolRegistry registers the default tool set.
assessRisk resolves the real target against run write roots and trusted folders.

claim: To add an agent tool: implement AgentTool in agent/tools/, register it in MarifoldRuntime.createDefaultToolRegistry, decide whether createHostContextTools, WorkspaceExecutor.executionTools, or SkillAppOperations.runProfileAgent should expose it, and add it to ChatTurns.chatTools only if it belongs in the chat loop; a new ToolKind also needs ApprovalPolicy defaults, ConfigLoader/ConfigManager parsing, and Web permission labels.

evidence.note: chatTools assembles the fixed caller-executed chat tool set.
executionTools: tools a guest device executes for a host run.

claim: ControlBlockTools.ts provides prompt-based <tool_call> tool calling for models without native tool support; AgentRunner switches to it when the provider rejects native tools in auto mode.

evidence.note: Loop switches to control-block mode after a native-tool rejection.

claim: MarifoldOpenAICompatProvider wraps Priest's OpenAICompatProvider and OpenAIResponsesProvider; endpointForRequest routes ChatGPT, Copilot Responses-only models (GITHUB_COPILOT_RESPONSES_MODELS), and hosted-search requests to the Responses API and everything else to Chat Completions, while the SDK owns request bodies and tool wire mapping. ProviderFactory builds adapters and resolves nativeWebSearchStrategy.

evidence.note: Wrapper over the SDK chat and Responses providers.
Adapter creation by type and nativeWebSearchStrategy.

claim: ProviderRegistry.ts enumerates provider entries: local ollama/llamacpp/lmstudio/rapidmlx, API providers such as openai, anthropic, gemini, deepseek, bailian, kimi, minimax, and openrouter, OAuth github_copilot/chatgpt/xai, and custom; every entry except ollama and anthropic uses the openai-compatible adapter type.

ProviderEngines.refreshCredentials refreshes GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and xAI OAuth credentials before chat turns, agent runs, and SkillApp operations; withOAuthCredentials serializes refreshes per config and provider and persists rotated tokens without overwriting a concurrent reauth.

evidence.note: Agent runs refresh credentials in prepareEngine.
Chat turns refresh credentials before building the engine.

claim: ChatTurns.ask and ChatTurns.stream run a bounded caller-executed tool loop (at most 3 iterations) over tools from ChatTurns.chatTools: web_search and read_web_page in fallback search mode and read_file when read approval is allow. MarifoldRuntime.resolveWebSearch picks native, fallback, or unavailable; provider-hosted search travels as providerTools and falls back to Marifold search on capability errors; memory payloads apply only from the final response.

evidence.note: chatTools assembles caller-executed chat tools under policy.
stream() tool loop, hosted-search fallback, final-response persistence and memory.

claim: MemoryControls.ts strips hidden <memory_save>/<memory_forget> blocks from output; chat turns apply the payloads through ChatTurns.applyTurnMemory and MemoryStore, while agent runs strip and discard them in AgentRunner.extractTurn.

evidence.note: applyTurnMemory applies payloads after a chat turn.
extractTurn strips and discards memory blocks in agent runs.

claim: ScheduleStore (croner cron, JSON files under [paths].schedules_dir) and Scheduler (30-second tick that records lastRunAt before running) fire unattended, scheduled-tagged agent runs through MarifoldRuntime inside marifold service; the service serves GET /v1/schedules and WorkspaceScheduleRoutes adds create/update/delete/run; the CLI is schedule.ts.

evidence.note: tick() records lastRunAt, then runs the schedule.

claim: ConfigLoader normalizes [web_search], [paths] (incl. schedules_dir, skills_dir, apps_dir), [service], [channel], providers, and [agent] through parsePartialAgentConfig, which profile.toml [agent] overrides share; resolveAgentConfig lives in ApprovalPolicy.ts, and ConfigManager.renderMarifoldConfig round-trips the sections.

createMarifoldService wires the runtime, scheduler, Telegram bridge, run registry, workspace manager and executor, then registers route modules (RunRoutes, SessionRoutes, ChatRoutes, ConfigRoutes, ProfileRoutes, SkillAppRoutes, TaskRoutes, WorkspaceRoutes, WorkspaceScheduleRoutes, StaticRoutes); it serves /health, /v1/status, /v1/changes, /v1/terminal/:operation, and GET /v1/schedules itself, with Security.ts, Validation.ts, and ServiceErrors.ts at the edge.

evidence.note: Security registration and hosted subsystems (scheduler, Telegram, workspace, run registry).
Error mapping, core routes, and route module registration.

claim: RunRoutes exposes live agent runs over a RunRegistry: POST /v1/runs, GET /v1/runs[/:id], resumable SSE /v1/runs/:id/events (sequence ids, Last-Event-ID replay), approval and input answers, steer, cancel, and artifacts. RunRegistry holds the abort handle, pending approvals/questions, steering queue, and sequenced event buffer; MarifoldRuntime.createRunRegistry builds it.

evidence.note: Events SSE, approvals, inputs, steer, cancel.

claim: SkillApps are statically compiled skillapp.ts templates in packages/core/src/app: compileSkillApp inspects the TypeScript AST without executing it; SKILL_APP_SCHEMA (v1, app-local Skill plus explicit model) and SKILL_APP_PROFILE_SCHEMA (v2, registered profile Skill) define the contract; AppStore loads <apps_dir>/<name>/skillapp.ts bundles; SkillAppOperations runs one operation; the service exposes /v1/apps and /v1/app-instances.

evidence.note: compileSkillApp inspects the AST and never evaluates it.

claim: MarifoldRuntime delegates chat turns to ChatTurns, engine creation, OAuth refresh, and Priest request config to ProviderEngines, and SkillApp operation execution to SkillAppOperations, wiring each through closures over its own methods so test spies still apply; ask() and stream() forward to ChatTurns.

SessionLeases keeps 60-second per-session leases in a SQLite file beside the sessions DB: acquire throws SESSION_BUSY for another owner, takeover moves a lease (and any running hold) to a new owner, and hold reserves the session for a running AgentRunner.run. The service exposes POST/DELETE /v1/sessions/:id/lease (body takeover: true), and @marifold/client renewSessionLease drives renewal for the TUI and Web UI.

evidence.note: acquire, takeover, assertAvailable, markInUse (list views), hold.
Lease and takeover routes keyed by x-marifold-session-owner.
Web lease renewal, pagehide release, takeOver.
TUI lease renewal and loss handling.

claim: The TUI App controller (packages/tui/src/ui/App.tsx) composes useApprovals, useRuns, and useSkills over the pure appReducer/applyAgentEvent state in core/appState.ts; runTui builds a local MarifoldRuntime or a service-connected WorkspaceShell over RemoteRuntime, and the CommonJS CLI loads the ESM TUI through a dynamic import for a bare marifold.

evidence.note: Dynamic ESM import and bare-marifold TUI launch with --resume/--takeover.

claim: The Web UI reaches core only over the service API: apps/web/src/api/types.ts is the only file that imports @marifold/core, type-only, enforced by a Biome noRestrictedImports override; threadReducer/applyRunEvent fold AgentEvents into run cards and RunFollowers owns one followRun loop per run.

evidence.note: Only file allowed to import @marifold/core, type-only.
applyRunEvent folds AgentEvents into run cards.
RunFollowers owns one follow loop per run.

claim: @marifold/client exports createApiClient (bearer token, per-client x-marifold-session-owner header, workspace-forwarded base URL), parseSse, the resumable followRunEvents, the session lease helpers, startupWorkspaces, and composerTokenBefore; the TUI, CLI, and Web UI share it and it does not depend on core at runtime.

evidence.note: createApiClient base URL, bearer token, session-owner header.
followRunEvents resumes from the last sequence id.

claim: Device-hosted workspaces: WorkspaceManager owns pairing, invitations, revocation, and one BridgePeer per workspace; WorkspaceRuns routes runs to an execution device (host context tools when it is a guest) and WorkspaceExecutor runs host-requested tools on a guest; the service forwards only workspaceApiPath-allowlisted routes through /v1/workspaces/:id/api/*; apps/bridge createBridge is the relay and workspace-protocol holds identities, membership certificates, and encryption.

evidence.note: WorkspaceManager state: store, peers, presence, handlers.
createRunner picks the default or host-context registry by execution device.
createBridge relay server and host registration.

claim: Skills (marifold.skill.v0) load through SkillStore from the global skills dir and each profile's skills/ dir, with profile skills shadowing global ones; parseSkillInvocation and resolveSkillInvocation resolve exactly one $skill before model execution, and MarifoldRuntime merges compiled built-in skills into listing and resolution.

evidence.note: SkillStore contract: global and profile scopes, shadowing.
